breakdown.description: Counter-flow flame requires opposing inlet velocities; both inlets set to +x
breakdown.reason: The generated specification sets both the fuel inlet and air inlet velocities to +0.1 m/s in the +x direction, directly repeating the original error. The ground truth requires the air inlet velocity to be -0.1 m/s (in the -x direction) to create the opposing counter-flow configuration. This inconsistency was not resolved.
